Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Engagement Growth Marketing team at Airbnb is at the intersection of marketing, engineering, and data science. Our work is imperative to driving the top line of the entire company. You will be a thought partner and trusted stakeholder to functional leads and business partners across Product, Data Science, Business Ops, Host Community, Marketing, Brand, and Creative teams to set and exceed aggressive growth targets.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Host), you will play a critical role in managing Airbnb's relationship with our Host community. Your responsibilities include driving the strategy, development, enhancement, and execution of lifecycle marketing programs and campaigns across email, push, onsite, and in-app notifications.

Success in this role means driving activation, engagement, retention, and reactivation of our Hosts while taking end-to-end responsibility from crafting strategy to evaluating performance against KPIs.

A Typical Day

· Identify, build, and implement Host lifecycle strategies and campaigns across multiple channels that nurture Hosts and drive incremental value to their experience.

· Drive a testing and learning agenda by conducting extensive experimentation and in-depth user data analysis to scale successful strategies through automation.

· Translate business goals into accurate delivery requirements, including specifying required data, segmentation logic, and dynamic content requirements.

· Own comprehensive reporting of all relevant KPIs, building dashboards to track performance and articulating results effectively to stakeholders and the wider business.

· Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Creative, to build roadmaps, own campaign development workflows, and evangelize the Host Engagement function.

Your Expertise

· 8+ years of CRM experience in a consumer-facing, fast-paced company with a proven track record of managing large-scale B2C automated lifecycle programs.

· Deep understanding of CRM strategy, marketing technology architecture, and relational databases, with experience working directly with Production and Engineering teams.

· Exceptional project management skills with the ability to navigate an evolving team structure and collaborate across teams from Engineering to Design.

· Proven quantitative and analytical skills, including high proficiency in Excel and reporting tools like Tableau, with intermediate SQL skills preferred.

· Superb verbal and written communication skills with a high degree of comfort interpreting results and communicating insights effectively to senior leadership.

· Passion for CRM and user engagement, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, an eye for user flow, and methodical problem-solving skills.

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and progressive experience.

Your Location

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states.

This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing lifecycle marketing tactics and programs to engage our developers throughout their journey to drive platform adoption, retention, and expansion.

In this role, you have expertise in product-led growth strategies and tactics, dynamic, personalized messaging involving mediums such as email, in-product, and web for B2B SaaS users. You are obsessed with customer success and advocate for our users as much as you work to accelerate their journey on MongoDB Atlas.
You have a solid knowledge of the customer journey, including onboarding, adoption, retention, monetization strategies and tactics, and running experiments both in and out of the product. This includes taking initiatives from ideation all the way through execution and continuous iteration.

You also have experience in database segmentation and marketing to developers or a highly technical audience to drive early-stage planning all the way through to cross-functional execution. You possess strong communication and collaboration skills.
This is a highly visible role that requires a change agent with natural leadership skills and the ability to work across multiple teams with members at different levels. You are adept at thinking strategically and tactically to get things done by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Analytics, Data Science, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations.
We are looking for an individual who is a problem solver, detail-oriented, collaborative, creative, data-driven, strategic, organized, and a trusted partner.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Tysons for our hybrid working model.
In particular, you will be
Partnering closely with the Product teams to create digital experiences for our customers to engage, retain, and grow existing users
Defining and executing marketing plans with the rest of the Growth Marketing team to keep project timelines updated and clear across all stakeholders while transforming ideas into concrete campaigns that achieve measurable outcomes
Continuously optimizing programs and channels through experiments and A/B tests
Collaborating closely with the product team to optimize user journey continuously, including implementing lifecycle tactics at critical stages like onboarding, activation, and re-engagement
Brainstorming relevant content pieces for net-new creation or ways to repackage existing content relevant for our users
Performing strategic product, market, and customer analyses to identify new growth drivers or opportunities for improvement
Uncovering and leveraging new emerging channels and opportunities to accelerate growth and workload expansion
Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on KPIs to ensure marketing initiatives reach revenue objectives
Working collaboratively with our product marketing and product team to align messaging and understand relevant product launches and moments to roll into each customer program or campaign

5+ years of B2D or B2B experience in lifecycle and/or growth marketing. Product-led growth experience desired (bonus points for experience/understanding with agent-led growth!)
Drive to provide the best possible experience to our customers and users
Deep understanding of marketing to developers or a highly technical audience required
Expertise in owning end-to-end execution and creating, implementing, and optimizing lifecycle campaigns across the customer journey
Understanding of and appreciation for the big picture (market, customers, company) but also the details to successfully scale programs
Passion to objectively measure your efforts and only make decisions based on data
A collaborative mindset - you love working with others and incorporating relevant feedback
An owner mentality - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get them to completion
Proven ability to turn initial ideas into successful, measurable programs that drive tangible results
Flexibility and adaptability - you enjoy working in ambiguity. You are calm and effective under pressure and able to pivot quickly. You excel at task prioritization and proper evaluation of situational urgency
Focus and drive - you know what matters and apply yourself with gusto, continuously exploring how much faster you can learn and execute
Experience or have a working knowledge of product-led growth strategies and KPIs
Strong writing skills and the ability to storyboard campaign themes and messages to develop compelling campaigns to bring to market

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
Location: This role is based out of our London office.

As a Senior Growth Manager, UK on Reddit’s International Community team, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team responsible for deepening Reddit’s presence in the market. This is not a marketing role. Rather, you will drive user and ecosystem growth by building and scaling communities, executing local growth initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and leading initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s local ecosystem and user experience.
This role combines strategic planning, growth-focused execution, cross-functional influence, market ownership, and community development. In this role, you will have a significant impact on shaping Reddit’s presence and success in the market, driving user and ecosystem growth at scale while strengthening engagement across local communities.

User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture local communities.
Growth Operations: Design, launch, and scale local growth programs aimed at strengthening Reddit's ecosystem of users, communities, and contributors. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by continuously testing and evaluating new ideas to reach your objectives.
Cross-functional collaboration: Serve as the local go-to person for providing market insights and local input to cross-functional teams, including Comms, Product, BD, and Marketing. Coordinate the execution of market-specific initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
Country Data Ownership: Monitor key country health KPIs and alert the appropriate teams in the event of significant changes (e.g., DAU, Contributions). Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and develop action plans accordingly.
Local representation: Serve as a local spokesperson for Reddit, building influential relationships and partnerships both on and off the platform to reach and attract new audiences.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
7+ years of experience in user growth, community growth, product operations, or country expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth programs at scale.
Entrepreneurial spirit, strong execution skills and an ability to take initiative and drive projects independently.
A strong blend of operational, growth, data, and community/content expertise.
Experience building communities and/or growing a user base through on-the-ground initiatives.
Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.
Passion for combining systems thinking with data analysis to drive impactful decisions.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams, users, content creators, and external partners.
Results-oriented mindset with a strong attention to detail and a bias toward execution.
Deep understanding of local market culture, including language, current events, politics, customs, traditions, topics of interest, and cultural sensitivities.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll design and execute multi-channel programs that guide developers and enterprise customers through their journey with Vercel—from onboarding and adoption to retention and expansion. Your work will directly influence how customers experience the platform, ensuring they realize the full value of Vercel’s products.
You’ll partner closely with the Growth Product Team, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Data to deliver personalized, impactful lifecycle communications that scale globally. This is a high-visibility role with the opportunity to impact both revenue and customer engagement.

End-to-end lifecycle campaigns across email, in-app, and other owned & paid channels to drive activation, adoption, and long-term retention.
Segmentation and personalization strategies that deliver timely and relevant messages to developers and enterprise stakeholders. Develop and maintain customer journey maps to identify friction points, optimize touchpoints, and design end-to-end experiences that drive conversion, retention, and loyalty.
Automated workflows and experimentation, building scalable programs with behavioral triggers, A/B testing, and data-driven optimizations.
Campaign measurement and reporting, surfacing insights on performance and recommending opportunities for continuous improvement.
Cross-functional alignment, ensuring lifecycle marketing supports Sales and Customer Success priorities and ties into Vercel’s broader GTM strategy.
Creative and content collaboration, partnering with design and product marketing to develop messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.

4+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or growth marketing, ideally within SaaS, developer tools, or B2B technology.
Proficiency with marketing automation tools (HubSpot, Iterable, Braze, Marketo) and analytics platforms (Amplitude, Segment, Looker, Mixpanel).
Proven ability to design and scale multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that drive measurable improvements in product adoption and retention.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of turning insights into actionable strategies.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical developers and enterprise buyers.
A growth mindset with passion for experimentation, iteration, and scaling lifecycle programs.

OpenAI's Marketing team helps customers understand, adopt, and get value from OpenAI's products and platform. The SMB Ads Marketing team is building the growth engine for small and medium-sized business advertisers: helping them discover the platform, sign up, launch campaigns, understand performance, and grow spend over time.
We take a data-driven approach to understanding customer needs, market dynamics, and funnel behavior. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing Operations, Design, and Communications to create a cohesive end-to-end advertiser experience and help businesses unlock value from OpenAI's advertising platform.

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Manager, SMB Ads to help build and execute high-velocity growth programs for small business advertisers. This person will work across acquisition, activation, lifecycle, and conversion, with an initial focus on helping advertisers move from interest and sign-up to first meaningful spend & retention over time
This is a hands-on growth role for someone who loves turning ideas into shipped experiments. You will build campaigns, lifecycle journeys, landing page tests, messaging tests, audience experiments, AI-assisted workflows, reporting improvements, and practical conversion programs. As the SMB Ads business grows, this role may continue to support acquisition and activation and expand deeper into same-store growth, lifecycle, retention, and repeat spend.

Execute growth experiments across acquisition, activation, lifecycle, and early retention.
Build email, in-product, landing page, audience, messaging, and offer tests that help SMB advertisers reach first spend and repeat value.
Use AI tools to prototype marketing assets, automate workflows, analyze funnel data, generate creative variations, and build internal growth systems.
Partner with Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing Operations to turn strategy into shipped experiments and measurable learnings.
Support improvements to sign-up, onboarding, campaign creation, measurement, and advertiser education.
Maintain experiment documentation, QA checklists, learnings, and performance readouts.
Translate ambiguous growth ideas into concrete tests, campaign plans, launchable assets, and clear next steps.
Help identify new ways to convert, activate, retain, and grow SMB advertisers.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth and this role is responsible for creating a delightful web experience that maximizes the number of leads we generate through our website. You’ll work directly with our engineering, data and design teams to develop a deep understanding of what resonates with our audience and build a unique, differentiated web experience that compels site visitors to become Ramp customers.
This is a role for someone who builds things before they're asked to.

You're the kind of person who has already stitched together AI tools to solve a problem, whether that's automating a reporting workflow, generating and testing landing page variants, or chaining together Claude, a no-code platform, and a spreadsheet to get something done that "wasn't your job." You don't wait for a perfect tool or a bigger team; you recognize the most valuable opportunity for Ramp and use your scrappiness to get there fast.

Drive net new leads for Ramp, with an emphasis on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) on our website and Top-of-Funnel demand generation campaigns.
Own the feedback loop of testing new copy, imagery, layouts, and engagement mechanisms on our website, analyzing the results, and sharing learnings with our broader Growth & Marketing teams.
Leverage web analytics tools to monitor website performance and uncover trends and opportunities.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Own the startup. The whole startup motion. We want 90%+ of every newly incorporated company in the US to start their financial life on Ramp, and we are giving one person the keys to make that happen.
This is not a marketing seat. You will be the general manager with the P&L. You own acquisition, product strategy, onboarding, pricing, incentives, positioning, lifecycle, and the pipeline number for the startup segment end to end. If a founder incorporates on a Tuesday, your job is to make sure they have a Ramp card by Wednesday and never need to think about a competitor. Every lever it takes to make that true is yours to pull, and the ones that don't exist yet are yours to build.
You will be based in San Francisco because this is fundamentally a community motion. The startup market does not get won on a billboard. It gets won at the demo day after-party, in the YC group chat, at the founder dinner, in the angel's DMs, and at the accelerator that just announced its batch.

We want someone the community already knows and trusts, ideally because you were one of them. You started a company. You raised money. You know what it feels like to incorporate on a Sunday night and need a card to buy your first server. You are still plugged into the up-and-comers, and they take your call.

You will be the glue between the builders at Ramp and the builders out in the community.
You will sit within the Growth team and run the segment like its own business. You will work directly with Product on what startups need first and how onboarding should feel. You will own the pricing and incentive structure for the segment. And you will be AI-native by default: you have already replaced a real chunk of your operating workflow with Claude or equivalents, and you have a point of view on how an agent-first GM org runs.
If you want to build, and you want to do it inside the company that is going to define how every American startup handles money, this is the role.

Own positioning. Define how Ramp shows up to a brand-new founder versus how we show up to a Series B CFO. Write the words. Own the comparison story against Brex, Mercury, and Every.
Own acquisition. Build the full motion: community and events, founder and angel networks, accelerator and incubator partnerships, programmatic and comparison SEO, paid, referral, and incentive-driven growth. Be physically present where startups form.
Own product strategy for the segment. Decide what startups need first from Ramp, what the day-zero product experience should be, and where the gaps are. Carry that to Product as the segment's voice.
Own onboarding. Make incorporation-to-funded-card the fastest, most obvious path in the market. Remove every step that loses a founder.
Own pricing and incentives. Design the offer that makes Ramp the default choice at incorporation. Run the incentive programs, partner credits, and founder perks that tip the decision.
Be the face. Represent Ramp in the startup community. Host the dinners. Speak at the demo days. Be the person founders associate with "the Ramp that gets startups."
Own the number. Tie it all together: drive toward 90%+ of all newly incorporated US startups starting on Ramp. Build the model, instrument the funnel from incorporation to activation, and report a single clean metric you live and die by.
What You Need
You have started a company, or you have operated at the founding-team level of an early startup and lived the incorporation-to-traction journey firsthand
You are deeply, currently embedded in the startup community: accelerators, angels, founder networks, the SF startup social scene. You can name the up-and-coming companies before they are obvious, and the community knows you back
5+ years across some combination of founding, growth, GTM, or general management, with clear evidence you can own an outcome end to end rather than one function
A GM instinct: you think in P&L, you make tradeoffs across product, pricing, and marketing, and you are comfortable owning a number with no one to hand it to
Demonstrable AI fluency: specific tools, workflows, or systems you have built or adopted that materially changed your output
Sharp written and verbal communication. You can write the landing page and command the room at the dinner
You live in or will relocate to San Francisco and will be in-market, in-person
Nice-to-Haves
You went through YC, Techstars, Neo, South Park Commons, or an equivalent program, or you ran one
You have an existing audience or following in the founder community
You have built a wildly popular AI tool, or agent that automated a repeatable workflow
Experience with fintech, banking, or developer-led product distribution
Familiarity with comparison and AEO SEO as a land-grab tactic
You have angel invested or advised early companies
Who this is not for...
This is not a marketing role with a fancy title. You own a P&L and a single brutal number.
It is not a remote or hybrid-anywhere role. The startup motion is physical and social and is largely centered in San Francisco. If you do not want to be at the dinners and demo days, this is not it.
It is not for someone who needs a defined playbook handed to them. You are building the machine, not running someone else's.

Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien. Wir suchen jemanden, der alle drei verbindet.
Erstens: Performance. Du führst Meta-Ads-Accounts für hochpreisigen E-Commerce - Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, lange Kaufentscheidungen, komplexe Customer Journeys. Du steuerst nach Geschäftszahlen (CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER), nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Wenn du verstehst, warum das richtig sein kann, bist du hier richtig.
Zweitens: AI - richtig eingesetzt. Wir sind eine AI-native Agentur. Das heißt bei uns: eigene MCP-Anbindung an die Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits und Anomalie-Erkennung, selbstgebaute Skills für Angle-Entwicklung und Skript-Bau.

Diese Werkzeuge sollst du nicht bedienen wie ein Formular, sondern führen wie ein Instrument: AI übernimmt das Wie (Analysen strukturieren, Varianten bauen, Daten durchkämmen), die Hypothese - das Was - bleibt deine. Wer jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam.

Wer jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, produziert denselben Output, den jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell auch bekommt. Beides scheidet aus.
Drittens: Creative Strategy. Bei High-AOV entscheidet das Creative, nicht der Kampagnen-Setup-Trick. Du musst keine Creatives produzieren, aber du musst sie lesen können: Warum gewinnt dieser Winner? Welches Segment, welche Kaufhürde, welcher Beweis fehlt im Funnel? Du entwickelst mit dem Creative-Team Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → Angle), verstehst, warum ein kalter Markt andere Hooks braucht als ein heißer, und liest Creative-Performance jenseits von Hook Rate und Thumbstop.
Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio und dem Anspruch, in unserer Nische die Beste in Deutschland zu sein. Unsere Kunden kaufen Urteilsvermögen, kein Button-Pushing: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und nicht nur Anzeigen ins System tippen.
Aufgaben
Du führst Accounts end-to-end: Audit → Hypothese → Test-Plan → Skalierung → Reporting.
Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers und inkrementellen KPIs; du verstehst warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht.
Du nutzt unseren AI-Stack als Standard-Werkzeug. Account-Audits, Breakdown-Analysen und Anomalie-Erkennung laufen AI-gestützt; du lieferst die Fragestellung, prüfst den Output und triffst die Entscheidung.
Du dekodierst Creative-Performance: Du erkennst, warum ein Winner gewinnt (Hook, Mechanismus, Einwandbehandlung, Proof), und übersetzt das in die nächste Test-Hypothese.
Du bringst eigene Angle- und Set-Piece-Hypothesen in die Creative-Planung ein: Welches Segment ist unterversorgt, welche Kaufhürde unbeantwortet, welches Stück Customer Journey fehlt.
Du sagst Kunden die harte Wahrheit, wenn der Bottleneck das Offer, die Landingpage oder das Produkt ist und nicht die Ads. Und du lieferst dazu immer einen Alternativweg.
Qualifikation

Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Führen von Meta-Ads-Accounts mit relevantem Budget
Du arbeitest täglich und tief mit AI: eigene Prompts und Workflows, Erfahrung mit LLM-gestützter Analyse. Du kannst konkret zeigen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
Du kannst eine fremde Winning-Ad auseinandernehmen und erklären, warum sie funktioniert. Nicht "gutes Video", sondern Zielgruppe, Mechanismus, Beweisführung.
Du kennst die Grundlogik von Awareness- und Sophistication-Stufen (Schwartz) oder Vergleichbares aus der Praxis: verschiedene Bewusstseinsstufen brauchen verschiedene Botschaften.
Du denkst in Geschäftszahlen und verstehst ROAS ≠ Deckungsbeitrag

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

Search is changing. Developers no longer just type queries into Google — they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, and, increasingly, they don't ask at all: their coding agents do.

When a developer prompts Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or v0 to build something, the framework, deployment target, and docs those agents reach for are decided before a human ever visits a website.

This is existential for Vercel: we're the agentic infrastructure platform for the agent era, agents already trigger more than half of our deployments, and being the answer that both AI assistants *and* coding agents surface, cite, and build with is quickly becoming as important as ranking on page one.
We're hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own Discoverability end to end: how easily developers, teams, AI assistants, and coding agents find, understand, and choose Vercel across every surface where discovery happens.

You'll own our organic footprint across traditional search (SEO) and answer engines (AEO/GEO) — where "answer engines" spans both conversational assistants and the coding agents developers build with — from the technical foundation that makes our content machine-readable to the content and structure that makes us the answer.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll set the discoverability strategy and execute it hands-on, partnering closely with Growth Product, Content, Web Engineering, and Developer Relations. You'll report to the Head of Growth and be a key driver of Vercel's product-led, self-serve growth engine.

Own Vercel's organic acquisition strategy across SEO and AEO/GEO, with clear goals for traffic, non-branded visibility, share of voice in AI answers, how often coding agents choose and recommend Vercel, and downstream signups.
Lead technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data (schema), Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, and internal linking — working directly in our stack and with Web Engineering to ship fixes.
Build our answer-engine strategy across both surfaces: (1) conversational assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google's AI surfaces, and (2) coding agents like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and v0.
Understand how each retrieves and cites content — including docs, llms.txt, structured data, and machine-readable references — and shape our surfaces so Vercel is the source they reference and the default they build with.
Partner with Content and PMM to build a scalable content and information architecture — programmatic pages, docs, comparison and solution pages, and editorial — that ranks and gets cited.
Define and own the measurement layer: instrument the funnel from organic and AI-referred discovery through to activation, choosing the tooling and building the dashboards that make discoverability performance legible to the wider company.
Run a continuous experimentation program (page structure, metadata, schema, content formats) and turn results into repeatable playbooks.
Own domain and technical health across our web properties in collaboration with Engineering — migrations, redirects, canonicalization, and international/localization structure.
Stay ahead of a fast-moving landscape and translate algorithm and AI-engine changes into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

6+ years in SEO, organic growth, or technical/growth marketing, with a track record of driving organic acquisition at scale — ideally for a product-led or self-serve business.

Equally strong on the content and strategy side: you know how information architecture, page structure, and editorial quality drive both rankings and citations, and you can partner with writers and PMMs to make it happen.
Early, hands-on perspective on AEO/GEO across both conversational assistants and coding agents — you've experimented with how they retrieve, cite, and act on content (docs, llms.txt, structured references) and have opinions grounded in real tests, not just theory.

This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Agentic Commerce is the most significant shift in digital payments since mobile. We are moving from a world where humans click "buy" to a world where AI agents negotiate, book, and transact on our behalf.
We are looking for a strategic commercial operator to help define and execute Adyen’s Go-to-Market strategy for this emerging channel. You will not just be selling a product, you will be building the playbook for how the world’s largest enterprises accept payments from AI agents.
This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of Commercial GTM Strategy, Account Management, and Product. You will work closely with Adyen’s leadership to take our "Universal Translator" strategy to the market.

Define the Playbook: You will take our Agentic Commerce offering from "Pilot" to "Scale." This means identifying the right first-mover merchants, structuring the commercial approach, and creating the feedback loop between the market and our Product team.
Consult, Don’t Just Sell: You will act as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders at our largest merchants, helping them navigate the hype, understand the infrastructure risks (fraud, identity), and architect their data feeds for the agentic economy.
Orchestrate the Ecosystem: You will be the commercial bridge between our merchants and the major AI platforms (OpenAI, Google, etc.), ensuring Adyen remains the neutral connector in a fragmented ecosystem.
Enable the Organization: You will turn your learnings into a GTM engine, collaborating with marketing to train our wider Sales and Account Management teams to speak fluently about tokens, LLMs, and agentic protocols.
Protect the Merchant: You will champion our "Merchant-First" principles, ensuring that as protocols evolve, they prioritize merchant control, data privacy, and liability protection.
The Innovation Lab: You will be operating in the epicenter of the AI boom. Your focus will be on securing and managing high-velocity pilots with US-based AI platforms (San Francisco/Seattle/New York).
Speed to Market: You will help our largest US enterprise merchants (Retail, Mobility, Platforms) launch their first "Instant Checkout" use cases, moving quickly to capture early market share.

A Strategic Builder: You are comfortable working with ambiguity. You don't need a finished brochure to have a commercial conversation; you can co-create a solution with a client.
Commercially Sharp: You have a track record of navigating complex enterprise organizations and driving strategic initiatives that result in real volume, not just press releases.
Technically Fluent: You can explain the difference between a Network Token and a Virtual Card to a CFO, and debate API schemas with a Product Manager. You understand the nuances of the payments stack.
Curious about AI infrastructure: You are not an ML engineer, but you follow how agentic systems are evolving - agentic frameworks, how AI agents make decisions and initiate transactions. Familiarity with emerging agent protocols and how model providers are approaching commerce is a plus.
Anti-Hype: You cut through the noise. You focus on solving real operational problems (inventory visibility, authentication, liability) rather than selling science fiction.
Collaborative: You thrive in a flat structure. You will be working closely across Commercial, Product, Legal, and Partnerships teams to clear hurdles, resolve challenges in real-time.
Experience: 6-8 years of experience in commercial-facing or GTM strategy roles. Previous experience in payments or financial technology is a plus
Why now?
Agentic commerce is in its infrastructure phase. The protocols, standards, and commercial models are being written and tested right now. In this role, you won't be executing an established playbook, you will be authoring it. Adyen processes payments for many of the world's largest, most sophisticated enterprises, which means the decisions we make here will shape how AI-initiated transactions work at scale, not just in theory.

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
About the opportunity
Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built within Booking Holdings consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)

A build role that owns the entire acquisition funnel for the named universe - from top-of-funnel demand generation to the deepest 1:1 account plays - weighted toward ABM depth. You run one tiered account-based motion: 1:1 & 1:few (ABM) where the value is, and a capped 1:many (Lead Gen) engine over the tail of the same named list.

The art of the role is allocating finite team capacity across tiers - protecting 1:1 depth (the deep committee deals fund the whole program) while running an efficient 1:many engine. Player-coach: with a two-person team you personally carry the top 3–5 marquee accounts.

Expect roughly 60% leadership / 40% own book; the discipline is protecting the leadership half when your own accounts heat up.

Own the target universe and the full funnel: tier the named list with BD; decide 1:1, 1:few, or 1:many treatment; set goals, capacity allocation across tiers (~70% toward ABM), and operating rhythm.
Run a capped 1:many Lead Gen engine over the tail - templated, archetype-segmented campaigns built with the shared Marketing Ops Specialist, routed cleanly to BD - deliberately bounded so it cannot crowd out the deep work.
Carry the marquee accounts yourself (player-coach); co-own named accounts with BD; guide committee mapping; own the multi-product narrative and land-and-expand path.
Direct bespoke content and exec engagement; build the playbook; define and own account-level and funnel measurement with MarOps/RevOps; lead and grow the team; sell the program internally.
What you will need (required)
6+ years in B2B marketing and/or sales, with 3+ years in ABM or named-account field marketing.
Full-funnel range - you can run both deep 1:1 ABM and scaled 1:many demand generation against a named list, with the judgment to allocate finite capacity (purely high-volume demand gen with no account depth is not the profile).
Player-coach appetite; demonstrated BD partnership; buying-committee fluency; multi-product selling; account + funnel measurement literacy; CRM/MAP fluency; people leadership; comfort building from scratch.

Travel/fintech/loyalty/marketplace or partnership-led experience; ABM-platform exposure; self-serve funnels; ITSMA/ABM certification; new-function or post-merger experience.
Why 70/30 (best-practice rationale)
At the leadership level, 70/30 keeps the function’s identity anchored in depth: the committee deals carry the revenue and are the fragile, hard-to-rebuild capability, while the scaled engine is a controlled feeder rather than a competing P&L. Capping Lead Gen at ~30% of team capacity lets one Marketing Ops Specialist and a bounded automation motion serve the tail without pulling strategists off marquee accounts. Recommended default when the strategic named list is the primary prize.
How we will measure success
Primary (70%): committee engagement depth, joint account plans adopted, exec milestones, pipeline influenced, multi-product expansion, and deal velocity on strategic accounts. Secondary (30%): qualified pipeline and meetings from the capped 1:many tier, funnel conversion, and graduation of warming tail accounts. Plus team growth and playbook quality.

We're looking for an ambitious PM ready to build Nelly's Growth function from scratch - owning the full journey from sign-up to habit across our software, AI, and fintech surfaces, with direct impact on NRR. If you want real ownership and zero hand-holding, this is it.
About Nelly
We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
What to expect: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly.

We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Translate Nelly's company vision into specific, prioritized bets across acquisition, activation, and monetisation, informed by data, experimentation, and customer behavior
Own the end-to-end user journey: from partial sign-up through setup, first value, and habit formation - across Nelly's software, AI, and fintech products, and continuously sharpen each stage
Build platform-level growth capabilities that compound across surfaces , not features that live in one place
Design and run a rigorous experimentation and measurement program. Form hypotheses, define metrics, ship A/B tests at high velocity, learn fast, and ship what moves the numbers
Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution
Inform pricing, packaging, and self-serve strategy in partnership with GTM and finance leadership - including how we package across software, AI, and fintech to drive expansion (vertical & geo)

Note: If you don't meet all the criteria, we still encourage you to apply and make the case for why you'd be a great fit. If you're exceptional talent, we're happy to adapt.
Shipped exceptional B2B/prosumer growth products in high-velocity environments - you care deeply about user outcomes and winning with the product
3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products
High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero
Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics
Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes
Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth
Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners
Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given
Experience with self-serve, freemium, or PQL-driven growth motions
Experience with high-growth SaaS products using usage or outcome-based pricing, where you owned strategies to drive net revenue retention (NRR) growth

BVG ticket or a Swapfiets membership to cruise through the city
Urban Sports membership to sweat, stretch, or sauna your way through the week
Top of the line working equipment
Flexible hours and a hybrid setup in the heart of Berlin
Enjoy up to 4 weeks of workation wherever inspiration hits
A cozy, dog-friendly office where good vibes are basically mandatory
A fridge full of cold drinks and snacks waiting to be claimed

On behalf of a fast-growing European HealthTech company, we are looking for an International Growth Manager (m/w/d) to lead its market entry and expansion across the Nordic region .
The initial focus will be on Sweden, Denmark, and Finland , with the objective of launching and scaling a digital healthcare offering in the rapidly growing market for medically supported weight management.
This is not a purely strategic position. You will take ownership of market entry, launch execution, and commercial growth. Working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing, Medical, and Legal teams, you will translate market insights into scalable and successful country launches.
Tasks
Develop and execute the market-entry strategy for Sweden, Denmark, and Finland
Conduct in-depth market assessments covering regulatory requirements, competitive positioning, patient needs, and local healthcare infrastructure
Build and continuously refine a repeatable Country Launch Playbook
Drive localization, legal and regulatory compliance, operational readiness, and local supply-chain integration
Own the commercial strategy and business case for each marketEvaluate pricing, reimbursement potential, unit economics, and key growth levers
Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across Product, Operations, Marketing, Medical, and LegalIdentify and establish strategic partnerships that support market access, brand development, and long-term commercial success
Monitor and optimize post-launch performance based on key metrics such as CAC, LTV, conversion, retention, and contribution margin
Lead strategic growth initiatives, including testing new business models, channels, and partnership opportunities across the Nordic region

At least three years of professional experience in strategy consulting, venture development, international expansion, or strategic growth
A strong academic degree in Business, Economics, or a related field
Fluency in English and Swedish or Danish
Finnish and German language skills are a strong advantage
A proven track record of launching or scaling businesses in new markets
Ideally, hands-on experience in Sweden, Denmark, or Finland
A strong understanding of the commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the Nordic markets
Excellent analytical skills and confidence in developing business cases and unit-economics models
The ability to translate data and complex market insights into clear strategic recommendations
A structured and systems-oriented approach, with a focus on creating scalable solutions rather than one-off processes
An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership, and a clear bias for action
The ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments
Confidence in working with senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams
This is a key position within the international growth strategy of an ambitious European HealthTech scale-up.
You will have the opportunity to build new markets from the ground up and directly shape both strategic direction and operational execution. The role offers significant ownership, high visibility, and a measurable impact on commercial performance.
It is particularly suited to someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, thrives in dynamic environments, and is motivated by turning complex market requirements into scalable growth models.

About Right Side Up

Please note, this posting is to highlight joining Right Side Up 's talent collective specifically and is not representing an internal full-time role, or a current opportunity with a client.
Right Side Up is a collective of premium marketing talent—with all of the marketing chops, and none of the agency fluff. We’re trusted by the most respected early-stage ventures, the fastest-growing tech companies, and well-established Fortune 500 teams to do one thing better: Growth . We have over 250+ clients including Stitch Fix, Sephora, Yelp, Sun Basket, Crunchbase, DoorDash, Calm, and more.

We’re seeking freelance Paid Search Growth Marketing Consultants to join our talent collective and support a range of clients across industries. This role is ideal for marketers who have experience scaling paid search programs and driving efficient, measurable growth in both early-stage startups and established companies.
Projects may include building paid search programs from the ground up, scaling existing campaigns, optimizing performance, and identifying new growth opportunities across search channels. Contract engagements typically range from 10–40 hours per week.

Partner with creative, CRO, and analytics teams to improve conversion rates and overall performance
Analyze performance data and provide actionable insights and recommendations
Identify opportunities to expand into new channels, formats, or markets

Strong experience managing and scaling paid search campaigns
Experience working in early-stage startup environments and/or established companies
Proven ability to drive measurable growth and improve efficiency at scale

Das sind wir
Das Berliner Institut für Innovationsforschung (BIFI) entwickelt wissenschaftlich fundierte Lösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Innovationsnetzwerke. Wir verbinden Forschung mit Praxis und begleiten Organisationen dabei, neue Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich zu entwickeln.
In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unsere Marke konsequent aufgebaut. Heute werden wir als innovativer, wissenschaftlich exzellenter und außergewöhnlicher Partner wahrgenommen. Nun beginnt die nächste Entwicklungsstufe. Wir suchen keine Person, die Marketing "macht". Wir suchen jemanden, der Marketing als strategischen Wachstumsmotor versteht.
Deine Mission
Du entwickelst einen Marketingprozess, der kontinuierlich qualifizierte Projektchancen für BIFI erzeugt. Du sorgst nicht nur für Sichtbarkeit, sondern dafür, dass aus Aufmerksamkeit Gespräche, Kooperationen, Forschungsprojekte und neue Kunden entstehen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und erhältst viel unternehmerischen Gestaltungsspielraum.
Aufgaben
Marketing als Business Development
Du entwickelst eine Marketingstrategie, die konsequent auf Unternehmenswachstum einzahlt.
Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, Zielgruppen und neue Chancen für BIFI.
Du entwickelst Maßnahmen, die qualifizierte Projektanfragen und Kooperationen erzeugen.
Du verstehst Marketing als Teil der Unternehmensentwicklung.
Thought Leadership & Content Strategy
Du entwickelst Inhalte, die Diskussionen anstoßen, Perspektiven verändern und Entscheidungsträger erreichen.
Du übersetzt komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in verständliche, relevante und außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsformate.
Du entwickelst Kampagnen mit klarem wirtschaftlichem Ziel statt reiner Reichweitenorientierung.
Performance & Experimentation
Du entwickelst neue Marketingideen, testest sie systematisch und optimierst sie datenbasiert.
Du etablierst einen reproduzierbaren Marketingprozess mit kurzen Lernzyklen.
Du definierst Erfolgskennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
Marke & Positionierung
Du entwickelst die Positionierung von BIFI kontinuierlich weiter.
Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Kommunikationsmaßnahmen unseren hohen Qualitätsanspruch widerspiegeln.
Du entwickelst Formate, die BIFI als außergewöhnlichen Innovationspartner sichtbar machen.
Digitale Kommunikation
Du verantwortest Website, Newsletter, LinkedIn und weitere relevante Kanäle.
Du entwickelst kanalübergreifende Kommunikationsstrategien.
Du analysierst Wirkung, Nutzerverhalten und Conversion entlang der Customer Journey.
Zusammenarbeit
Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Projektteams und externen Partnern zusammen.
Du bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein und hinterfragst bestehende Vorgehensweisen.
Du verstehst Dich als Sparringspartner für strategische Fragestellungen rund um Wachstum und Positionierung.

abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im strategischen Marketing, Business Development, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion
Erfahrung im Aufbau von Marketingprozessen und Kampagnen mit messbarer Wirkung
sehr gutes Verständnis digitaler Marketingkanäle sowie moderner Marketing- und Analysewerkzeuge
analytisches Verständnis für Kennzahlen, Conversion und Marketingperformance
hervorragendes Sprachgefühl und ausgeprägte konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten

denkst unternehmerisch.
möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen.
arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert.
hinterfragst Bestehendes und entwickelst mutige Ideen.
hast Freude daran, Neues auszuprobieren.
triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und Wirkung.
kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären.
möchtest gestalten statt verwalten.

Unternehmerische Wirkung
Du entwickelst Marketing nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern als strategischen Wachstumstreiber. Deine Ideen schaffen neue Kontakte, Kooperationen und Projekte – und leisten einen direkten Beitrag zur Entwicklung von BIFI.
Gestaltungsfreiraum & strategische Verantwortung
Bei uns setzt Du nicht nur Maßnahmen um, sondern entwickelst die Marketingstrategie aktiv mit. Du erhältst den Freiraum, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren, Experimente zu initiieren und erfolgreiche Ideen nachhaltig zu etablieren.
Innovation & unternehmerisches Denken
Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld zwischen Innovationsforschung, Zukunftstechnologien, Nachhaltigkeit und Konsumentenverhalten. Wir suchen Menschen, die Chancen erkennen, neue Perspektiven entwickeln und Marketing als Business Development verstehen.
Teamkultur mit Haltung
Ein diverses Team, flache Hierarchien und offene Kommunikation prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir vertrauen auf Eigenverantwortung, schätzen konstruktiven Austausch und entwickeln Ideen gemeinsam weiter.
Flexibles Arbeiten & Vereinbarkeit

Kreativer Arbeitsplatz mit Sinn

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in Canada. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.
As our first marketing hire in Canada, your work will shape how Canadian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Canada's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.
Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.
Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Canadian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.
Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.
Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.
Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.
Deep knowledge of the Canadian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.
Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.
Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

Landor is looking for a Senior Growth Manager to join our London studio. Could this be you?
We are Landor, part of WPP
World-leading brand experts,
underpinned by the most expansive strategic & creative capabilities in our category.
We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.
We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.
Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

As a Senior Growth Manager, you will drive new business and strategic growth across Landor’s full range of services—from brand strategy and identity to experience design, culture, and digital transformation. You’ll lead pitches, manage incoming leads, and build relationships across Landor and WPP to help us win exciting new work.
Lead pitch processes from the initial brief through to proposal writing, chemistry meetings, and final presentations.
Represent and champion all of Landor’s core offers, including Strategy, Design, Experience, Culture, and Brand Performance.
Qualify inbound leads by researching prospective clients, their business challenges, and their market context to decide if it's the right fit.
Work with subject matter experts across the business to build winning pitch teams and pull together compelling proposals.
Partner with Finance to lead commercial negotiations, set fees, define scopes, and manage project pricing.
Research agency competitors to understand their offers and use those insights to shape Landor’s winning pitch strategy.
Brief pitch teams thoroughly using desk research, brand data, and network insights so everyone understands the client's big challenges.
Partner with WPP teams and internal growth networks to identify cross-selling opportunities and re-engage lapsed clients.
Use our marketing campaigns, events, and thought leadership to connect with prospects and warm up new business leads.
Support the Growth Leadership team in tracking revenue targets, forecasting pitch pipelines, and building growth plans.
Use AI tools intelligently to speed up prospect research, competitive analysis, and pitch prep.
What you’ll need
Solid experience in business development, growth, or senior client management within a creative or branding agency.
A broad understanding of full-service branding, including strategy, visual identity, physical/digital experience, and company culture.
Proven track record of running successful, organized pitch processes and delivering proposals under tight deadlines.
Commercial confidence with experience managing pitch budgets, fee negotiations, and contract scopes.
Great storytelling skills with the ability to find the creative "hook" that makes a proposal stand out from the competition.
Confidence presenting to and building relationships with senior brand leaders and C-suite executives.
Strong research skills with the ability to quickly get up to speed on a prospective client’s business model and industry challenges.
A collaborative mindset with a talent for bringing multidisciplinary teams together under pressure.
Knowledge of the wider agency landscape, competitor positioning, and modern marketing trends.
Natural networking abilities to build strong relationships across internal agency teams and partner networks.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
We build brands. We build futures. Landor, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics, committed to a culture of respect where everyone belongs and can progress in their careers.

Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours.
The Role: As Seer's founding growth hire, you'll build and own Seer's growth & demand motion from first touch through qualification, building quality relationships with digital and marketing leaders. Seer has 20+ years of relationships, a founder with a strong sense of community, and a library of research that opens doors.

Your job is turning that into demand: building genuine relationships with the right people, qualifying real opportunities from polite interest, and collaborating with Business Development.

You're consultative enough to hold an executive-level conversation about digital marketing without backup, resourceful enough to build your own playbook, and grounded enough to clean your own HubSpot data. You're chasing fit & value delivery over volume, measured on the pipeline you create, not the activity you log.
Role Highlights
Pipeline & Account Development You'll build pipeline from two motions. First, Seer's warm community (roughly 40% of your focus): through events, webinars, tradeshows, long term relationships, former clients, and the audiences our thought leadership has already earned.

You'll prioritize by recency, context, and fit, and every touch will carry a specific reason to talk. Second, net-new high-fit accounts (roughly 60%): targeted, personalized outreach using HubSpot, LinkedIn, and a strategic account based approach. No cold-call flooding, no mass sequences.

You'll maintain enough pipeline coverage to consistently deliver quality first meetings against your targets.
Consultative Relationship Building & Qualification You'll develop early-stage relationships with senior marketing and digital leaders, holding credible conversations about SEO, paid media, analytics, and AI without needing to loop in an SME from the start. Just as important: you'll qualify with discipline.

You can separate a real opportunity from a friendly conversation, you know when to walk away, nurture, and you document why. When an opportunity is real, you'll bring in the BizDev team with a handoff that feels natural, not transactional, and you'll help shape what a great warm introduction looks like at Seer.
Measurement & Reporting You'll track your inputs and your conversions, and leadership will see your pipeline contribution in reporting without having to ask for it. You'll double down on the plays that create pipeline and cut the ones that don't, and you'll be honest about which is which.
CRM & Data Operations You'll own your data and operational infrastructure in HubSpot: data quality standards, ICP targeting, list building, and the operational workflows that will scale this function. You'll keep handoffs into BizDev's pipeline clean and trackable.
Campaign Activation & Market Intelligence Seer's research, webinars, and events are your fuel, but you're not just waiting on the calendar. When Seer releases an AIO study or hosts a webinar, you'll have an activation plan ready to convert that attention into conversations.

And when you see a campaign that would help you hit your targets, you'll ideate it, get creative, and own it, pulling in the editorial, marketing, client, and BizDev teams to bring it to life.

You'll represent Seer at industry conferences to build relationships that matter, and working in the field, you'll synthesize what's resonating and bring those signals back to sharpen positioning and inform where marketing invests next.

You qualify with discipline: you can tell us about an opportunity you walked away from and how you knew

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

At Verkada, we push traditional boundaries, and our B2B growth efforts are no exception. We’re looking for a Digital Growth Manager to own the growth thesis and pipeline outcomes for a set of our most strategic segments and verticals.
Reporting to the Director of Digital Marketing, you'll be one of the seasoned operators on the team — the person who decides where we play, sets the strategy, and is accountable for whether it works.

This is a player-coach role: you'll define the campaign roadmap for your segments, allocate budget across channels, and set the bar for how the team briefs, tests, and measures — and you'll personally run your highest-leverage campaigns end-to-end. You lead by doing the work at the standard you expect from everyone else, not by handing it off.

Own the Pipeline Number: Carry the pipeline and acquisition target for your segments. You own the outcome — not just the campaigns that feed it — and you make the calls on what to double down on and what to pull back

Budget and quarterly priorities are set collaboratively across the team — you're expected to shape that process with a strong, data-grounded point of view and ideas that raise our standards, not wait to be told where to focus.

You'll shape how we — and the wider org — tackle growth problems: bringing ideas to the table, partnering as a peer with Product Marketing, Sales, and Creative leadership to align on where growth investment goes, and raising the bar for the specialists you work alongside through direct feedback and example.
Define How We Measure: Own the metrics framework for your segments — decide what "working" means, and drive the team toward outcomes rather than activity.

6–9 years of experience in B2B marketing, growth, biz ops, strategic consulting, or an equivalent operating role — evaluated on the outcomes you've driven, not pedigree
A track record of ownership: You've owned a pipeline or revenue number, a program, or a channel P&L, and can point to results you're directly accountable for
Strategic judgment: You form a clear point of view on where to invest and why, and you've made the calls — including the hard "no's" — that shaped where a team spent its time and budget
Technical depth: You understand the mechanics of how modern paid channels and the marketing stack (e.g., Marketo, SFDC, attribution) actually work, and you can go as deep as your specialists when it matters
Quantitative fluency: A "math-first" brain. You reason about performance from the data and set the analytical bar for the team
Leadership without ego: You develop people, give direct feedback, and raise the standard of everyone around you. You bring a strong point of view and the credibility to back it
