Who we are
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.
What you'll own
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.

2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality
German and English \- both C1\+

Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep
Why this role
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.

"Insanely great" for families — delivered now
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.

We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.
Was du ownst
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.
Meta \& Creatives. Du planst, launchst und optimierst unsere Meta\-Kampagnen. Du treibst die Creatives, die sie füttern – Static und Video – von Inhouse\-Produktion bis zum Briefen und Steuern von Agenturen. Du weisst: Eine Gewinner\-Ad ist kein Glückstreffer, sondern eine Testing\-Pipeline.

Neural Frames makes AI music videos. Musicians, producers and labels use it to turn their songs into visuals that actually move with the music, from full music videos to short-form clips.
We're bootstrapped, profitable and growing fast. We got to several million in ARR with a team of about a dozen people, almost entirely through product and SEO. Now we're getting serious about growth, and creators are one of our biggest bets.
You'll be one of our first growth hires, and the creator channel will be yours to own: which creators we work with, what we offer them, what the content looks like, and how all of it connects to signups and revenue.
You won't start cold. We work with an external agency that has built creator programs before, and they'll train you on how to run ours: sourcing, outreach, briefs, deal structures, what tends to work and what doesn't. Expect to learn a lot, fast. From there you take over and scale it, working directly with the founder and seeing within weeks whether your ideas show up in the numbers.
If this works, creator content becomes one of the main ways people discover Neural Frames. And if there's appetite, the role can expand into other parts of growth over time.
Tasks
Find and recruit creators across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube: musicians, producers, AI and video creators, ideally before everyone else has noticed them
Get them publishing: briefs, concepts, challenges and campaigns around launches, new features and cultural moments
Test incentives until you find what works: flat fees, free credits, affiliate commissions, bonuses, competitions
Recruit and activate high-potential affiliates into our existing affiliate program
Turn individual creators into a community, not a list of one-off deals
Track everything back to traffic, signups, revenue and CAC, and double down on what performs

2+ years in creator, influencer, affiliate or growth marketing, and you've personally recruited and managed creators rather than briefing an agency to do it
Strong instincts for short-form content: you can tell why one video gets 400 views and another gets 4 million
You think in signups, revenue and CAC, not impressions
Organized enough to run dozens of creator conversations, deadlines and campaigns at once
Proactive and independent: you soak up what the agency teaches you, then run the program on your own
Genuinely into music, AI and internet culture
You live in Berlin, or are ready to move

You've built a creator, ambassador or affiliate program before
Existing relationships with creators in music, AI or video
You make short-form content yourself

This is a growth role, so it comes down to numbers: active creators per month, videos published, traffic and signups from creator content, affiliate revenue, and the CAC of the channel.
We don't want occasional sponsored posts. We want hundreds of creators who genuinely use neural frames, make things with it, and bring the next wave of musicians with them.

Job purpose
The Growth Marketing Manager – Financial Solutions leads the marketing strategy for BELAY's Financial Solutions service line, with responsibility for driving pipeline, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency. As the service line's marketing subject matter expert, this role develops a deep understanding of the ideal customer profile (ICP), customer needs, market dynamics, and BELAY's value proposition to inform positioning, campaigns, and growth strategies.
This role partners closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative, and other Marketing functions to translate business and customer insights into measurable growth initiatives. The Growth Marketing Manager also leads a team responsible for executing and optimizing marketing strategies across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and ongoing engagement.
Essential Functions
As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.
People Leadership & Planning
Lead, coach, and develop team members while establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings focused on feedback, development, and performance.
Manage internal resources, contractors, and vendors to effectively execute marketing priorities.
Partner with the Director of Marketing to establish and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing priorities.
Foster strong collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and other key business partners.
Growth & Financial Performance
Own Marketing's contribution to Financial Solutions pipeline and revenue growth.
Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to develop growth forecasts, lead projections, and performance targets.
Monitor marketing investment against pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and ROI, adjusting strategies and spend based on performance.
Develop data-driven business cases and recommendations for new marketing investments and growth opportunities.
Regularly present business performance, insights, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.

Serve as the Marketing subject matter expert for Financial Solutions, developing a deep understanding of the ICP, customer needs, buying behaviors, competitive landscape, and service line value proposition.
Use customer insights, market trends, competitive research, and performance data to inform marketing strategy, segmentation, and messaging.
Conduct regular competitive analysis, including an annual SWOT analysis, to identify opportunities and potential threats.
Own the marketing funnel from awareness through qualified pipeline, partnering with Sales to improve lead quality and conversion.
Develop and execute integrated, omnichannel acquisition campaigns across owned, paid, partner, and other relevant channels.
Identify opportunities to expand into new audiences, verticals, and channels and develop cross-sell strategies across BELAY service lines.
Partner with Content, Creative, Paid Digital, and external vendors to execute ICP-aligned campaigns and support service line growth.
Experimentation & Optimization
Develop and maintain a cross-channel experimentation roadmap across paid media, sponsorships, landing pages, messaging, offers, and nurture programs.
Design and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests to improve conversion, acquisition efficiency, and customer engagement.
Prioritize growth initiatives and experiments based on business impact, resources, data, and strategic alignment.
Scale high-performing strategies while optimizing or discontinuing underperforming initiatives.
Stay current on marketing trends, technologies, and emerging channels to identify new opportunities for sustainable growth.
Marketing Operations & Sales Enablement
Leverage Salesforce, HubSpot, and other marketing technologies to support campaign execution, reporting, funnel visibility, and optimization.
Ensure brand consistency and alignment across Financial Solutions campaigns and channels.
Provide Sales with messaging, content, tools, and resources that support lead conversion and revenue generation.
